correctness.rationale: Proof covers every n>=3 by a complete hub-spoke cone decomposition. An explicit deletion/link proof of the path recurrence gives all link dimensions; only n=3 has an augmented-empty link and is treated separately. In n=3q+1 the endpoint link is contractible and B1->A is a homotopy equivalence; all other needed cone maps are null by connectivity or a contractible base. Thus homotopy pushouts give integral sphere wedges, not just mod-2 ranks. Complete independent mod-2 ranks for 3<=n<=15 corroborate all finite base patterns.

value.rationale: A canonical infinite family of maximal outerplanar graphs is classified by exact integral homotopy type in all parameter values, refining the 2024 broad wedge-existence theorem with a nontrivial period-three dimension/multiplicity law and a link-nullity mechanism. It supplies a family-wide closed formula not implied by merely knowing the complex is a wedge or by knowing its matching polynomial.
